_note: Parks that require a timed-entry or vehicle/parking reservation to visit, keyed by entity id. Verified against nps.gov + recreation.gov on 2026-09-07 for the 2026 season. Re-verify each spring — seasons, prices and URLs change year to year. Arches, Glacier, Mount Rainier and Yosemite all dropped timed entry for 2026 and are intentionally NOT listed.

nps:romo.name: Timed-entry reservation
nps:romo.summary: Rocky Mountain National Park requires a timed-entry reservation from Friday, May 22 through about October 13, 2026 (the Bear Lake Road corridor runs a few days longer). Two permits are sold on Recreation.gov: “Timed Entry” (all areas except Bear Lake Road, needed 9 a.m.–2 p.m.) and “Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road” (needed 5 a.m.–6 p.m.). Reservations open May 1 for late May/June, then on the 1st of each prior month; 40% of each day’s slots release at 7 p.m. MDT the night before. $2 processing fee. No reservation needed outside those hours or dates.

nps:acad.name: Cadillac Summit Road vehicle reservation
nps:acad.summary: A vehicle reservation is required to drive the Cadillac Summit Road from May 20 through October 25, 2026 — either a Sunrise or a Daytime reservation. 30% of slots release on Recreation.gov 90 days ahead (10 a.m. ET) and 70% two days ahead. $6 per vehicle, plus a valid park entrance pass. No reservation is needed to enter the rest of Acadia.

nps:hale.name: Summit sunrise reservation
nps:hale.summary: Entering the summit district of Haleakalā between 3 a.m. and 7 a.m. for sunrise requires a per-vehicle reservation, booked on Recreation.gov up to 60 days ahead, with a second batch released 2 days ahead. $1 fee; one ticket per customer every three days; bring the confirmation and a matching photo ID. No reservation is needed after 7 a.m. or in the Kīpahulu (coastal) district.

nps:shen.name: Old Rag day-use ticket
nps:shen.summary: Hiking the Old Rag area — including the Ridge, Saddle and Weakley Hollow fire roads — requires a $2 day-use ticket from March 1 through November 30, in addition to a park entrance pass. 800 tickets are released per day on a rolling window on Recreation.gov; none are sold at entrance stations. The rest of Shenandoah and Skyline Drive need no reservation. (A parking-lot construction project runs at the Old Rag trailhead through much of 2026.)

nps:cave.name: Cavern timed-entry reservation
nps:cave.summary: Entering Carlsbad Cavern on the self-guided route (Natural Entrance or elevator) requires a timed-entry reservation on Recreation.gov — released 30 days ahead and up to 7 a.m. MT on the day of. $1 per ticket; the park entrance fee is paid separately at the visitor center. You enter any time between your reserved slot and 2:30 p.m. Ranger-guided tours are booked separately.

nps:muwo.name: Parking or shuttle reservation
nps:muwo.summary: Every vehicle and every shuttle rider needs a reservation to visit Muir Woods — there is no drop-in parking. Book a parking spot or a shuttle seat in advance at GoMuirWoods.com (not Recreation.gov). The park entrance fee is separate.
